summaries.GN21-L5-ENDPOINT-COMPACTNESS-CONTINUITY-: The generic Lemma 5 statement explicitly assumes continuity on each compact endpoint-parameter domain. Continuity on the source’s open policy domain alone is not treated as a proof of extension to the limiting endpoints.
summaries.GN21-L5-GLOBAL-POLICY-CONTINUITY-REGULAR: The generic Lemma 5 continuity premise quantifies over all TripPolicy centers and comparison policies. This is broader than the source-open domain; the added quantification is a current-proof premise, not evidence that the source theorem requires it.
summaries.GN21-L5-GLOBAL-POLICY-RESPONSE-SHAPE-REG: The generic Lemma 5 shape premises quantify over every policy in the near-optimal reward band, beyond the source-open domain, and explicitly state the quasi-shape comparisons involving zero trip length. The memo gives their precise scope.
summaries.GN21-T4-GLOBAL-POLICY-CONTINUITY-REGULAR: Theorem 4 uses the paper's assumed policy continuity on the acceptance-set domain of the formalization.
